new_candidates.body:
**Environment:** Ubuntu 24.04, aarch64 (Jetson Orin Nano), ROS 2 Jazzy binaries, nav2_mppi_controller 1.3.13.

**What happens.** The configuration error from #5574 -- MPPI's CostCritic with `consider_footprint: true` while the local costmap has no `footprint` -- is reported cleanly by a stand-alone `controller_server`:

    Original error: Considering footprint in collision checking but no robot footprint provided in the costmap.
    -> configure fails, the process stays up

Composed (the default, `use_composition: True`), the same error kills the whole container instead, and the message is never printed:

    [controller_server]: Inconsistent configuration in collision checking. ...
    Magick: abort due to signal 11 (SIGSEGV) "Segmentation Fault"...
    [ERROR] [component_container_isolated-1]: process has died [... exit code -6 ...]

(The "Magick" label is the GraphicsMagick handler of #4703 -- still in Jazzy 1.3.13; with the map server out of the container it shows as exit code -11.)

**Backtrace** (gdb, `catch throw`): the `ControllerException` is thrown in `mppi::critics::CostCritic::initialize()`; then, while the half-built controller is deleted:

    #0  ?? ()                                    <- in libmppi_critics, near CostCritic::initialize
    #1  mppi::ParametersHandler::~ParametersHandler() () from libmppi_controller.so
    #3  class_loader::ClassLoader::onPluginDeletion<nav2_core::Controller>(...)
    #6  nav2_controller::ControllerServer::on_configure(...)

Likely (not proven): the critic registers a dynamic-parameter callback before it throws; class_loader then warns "Attempting to unload library while objects created by this loader exist", and `~ParametersHandler` destroys a callback whose code is unloaded. Stand-alone, the library stays loaded.

**Reproduce:** compose `nav2_controller::ControllerServer` with MPPI, CostCritic `consider_footprint: true`, local costmap with `robot_radius` only (or the container given no `--params-file`, so the child costmap falls back to defaults -- how we hit it), then configure. The stand-alone control with the same file fails cleanly.

**Expected:** a clean configure failure with the message, as stand-alone.

Not checked on Kilted/Rolling.

***This is a report created by Claude Code.  I will vouch for it as the user of Claude Code. Thx
